A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel method for producing PPS composites reinforced by both short carbon fibers and nano-TiO particles.

we have shown that it is possible to improve the tribological behavior of PPS composites by using short CFs and sub-micro-sized TiO particles, which are not only cheap, but also environmentally friendly.

we have developed an effective and simple method to prepare PPS composites reinforced with carbon fibers and TiO particles, and have investigated the tribological behavior of the PPS composites under dry friction conditions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of short carbon fibres and sub-micro particles to polyphenylene sulphide can improve the friction and wear behaviour of the material.
